算法技术; 过滤气泡; 戳泡运动; 社会气泡; Abstract： Algorithmic recommendation technology has solved the annoyance of information flooding,whereas it may also result in effects such as Information Cocoons and Echo Chamber,creating Filter Bubbles and leading to Group Polarization.In recent years,some western media as well as data companies have launched a series of Burst Your Bubbles Movement through a variety of methods to present information,in an effort to restore an objective world.With regard to the cases in China,the Filter Bubbles include both commercial bubbles constructed by personalized recommendation technologies and social bubbles constructed by group biases during the transition period.When the public has stereotypes and negative emotions,the public will start procedures of selective understanding,selective filtering and selective memory,form a closed social bubble,and achieve emotional identification and moral mobilization.Some media and commercial companies will also cater to the social bubbles,pushing similar information on a large scale and creating an effect of Take a Ride on Hot Events.Therefore,Filter Bubble is the result of the joint action of technology,human nature and social structure.The elimination of Filter Bubble needs the optimization of technology,the balanced coverage by the media,the relief of social conflicts,improvement of public sphere and the expansion of the channels of institutionalized participation.
